hypothesis: Independent semantic evidence pages, read conditionally on a natural criterion, can support unseen fields without mapping the criterion onto a fixed global registry. Cached page encodings may amortize repeated questions without changing the exact executor.
basis: CBF0-5 pooled linear and antipodal interfaces are retired. CBF6-7 relation interfaces failed fresh transfer. CBF8 domain support improved development grounding but the selected arm's recorded final G0/G5/G6 fail; independent reconstruction remains required. The new intervention changes the representation unit and question-conditioned state reader, not the old four-field head width.
scope: Authored English mechanism assay only. No neutral benchmark, native human Boolean/intent/compliance, language, certification, long-context, high-K parity or competitor superiority credit. All endgame requirements and the 0.01 final quality NI margin remain unchanged.

canonical_dependency.reuse: Use canonical DecisionIR/StateBlock/Candidate/Evidence and EncoderPool/masked_mean. One DecisionIR per dataset example. Do not create a parallel IR. Canonical dependency is explicit research-only; no portable release claim. Do not edit the frozen master product.
canonical_dependency.neural_serialization: Semantic StateBlock.text only, grouped into candidate-owned pages using private structural provenance. Exact blocks, source/group IDs, page IDs, candidate IDs, gold, grades, field/family labels, rationale and annotation metadata never enter tokenization. Serialize a cross pair as tokenizer(question, text_pair=page_text). No numbers are reconstructed neurally.

encoder.feature: FP32 final-layer masked mean over nonpadding tokens of the frozen 12-layer base encoder, width384; existing EncoderPool with Identity projection; native pooler/classifier unused
encoder.forwards: Page encodings depend only on page text and pinned encoder/tokenizer/serialization. Questions encoded separately once. Cross control jointly encodes each question/page and cannot reuse page features as a substitute. Persist actual input IDs/masks and actual forward counters.

corpus.license: New authored shipping-train material only; pretrained checkpoint remains conditional/review
corpus.fields: Three distinct independent properties A/B/C per family. A trains, B is development-only, C is final-only. Field descriptions, five ordered grade rubrics and all wording inventories freeze before model execution. Families with held fields must differ in actual meaning, not just rename one field.
corpus.authorship: Separate grade/rubric authorship from opaque meaning review. Each property has five ordinal extent levels0..4, at least three distinct page wordings per level, and train/development/final question inventories for both orientations. Grade means extent of the named property, not a universal positive sentiment. No numeric tokens or literal grade names in semantic evidence.
corpus.grouping: Whole independently sampled world is one split unit. Every candidate, paraphrase, polarity, composition, K variant, erase/swap intervention and serialization variant from that world stays together. Deterministic seed1729, hash ranks over opaque world IDs; disjoint world IDs and semantic text/template inventories. Derived swaps are not independent observations.
corpus.field_sampling: Each main world contains four distinct properties with balanced deterministic family schedules. Train/validation/calibration use first12 families and A fields. Development uses first16 families and B fields. Final contains all20 families and C fields, balancing the last4 family holdout stratum. Each world has four main candidates, four page properties per candidate, uniformly balanced ordinal extent grades.
corpus.queries: Per world emit both orientations of each of the four present properties, one absent-property criterion, one two-term equal-weight composition and its full reversal. Positive/negative question wording split-disjoint. Dataset examples each emit one canonical DecisionIR; private metadata retains gold scalar, page ownership, grade provenance, term parse, source world and evidence attribution. Gold must be generated from authored meaning, never from model scores.
corpus.missing_contradictions: For each world retain original and paired variants that remove every page for one relevant property, or introduce a separate contradictory grade page for that property in one candidate. Any candidate with missing or conflicting required evidence makes the whole choice UNKNOWN, since ignoring a potentially winning unknown candidate is unsound. Absent-property queries are UNKNOWN. This is an explicit authored assay convention, not a universal missing-data theorem.
corpus.robustness: Main K4; deterministic candidate-count probes K2/8/16/32/64, two permutations, opaque candidate renaming, page reorder and question reorder. All maximal winners are gold; semantic ties use a stable identity ordinal outside model input. Permutation/renaming comparisons map back to source identities. Do not count robustness variants as independent worlds.
corpus.audit: Before any feature capture freeze source hashes/IDs, grade order, question orientation/target and exact term factors. Independent opaque reviewers receive only page text/rubric or question plus neutral field descriptions, not gold/family/split labels. Audit every unique page wording and question; disagreement/ambiguity blocks execution. Preserve raw reviews/rejects, never force acceptance. Any correction is preregistered before outcomes and preserves old lineage.

page_reader.equations: z_j=Wp*h_page_j; relevance_j=z_j dot (Wqa*h_q)/sqrt64; a=softmax(relevance); direction_j=tanh(z_j dot (Wqd*h_q)/sqrt64); value_j=sigmoid(wv dot h_page_j+bv); score=sum_j a_j*(0.5+direction_j*(value_j-0.5)); known=sigmoid(bk+softplus(uk)*max(relevance)-softplus(vk)*sum_j a_j*(value_j-sum_l a_l*value_l)^2). Bias-free projections; scalar value bias and knownness scalars only.
page_reader.loss: Sum of equal-weight relevance cross entropy onto uniform relevant-page target, raw page-grade normalized MSE, orientation squared error on relevant pages, and candidate known/unknown BCE. Grade/orientation losses masked for undefined contradictory/irrelevant targets. Unknown examples still train knownness. Report every component separately; no loss-weight search.
page_reader.exact_composition: Typed authored grammar only: two atomic clauses joined by '; also', optional explicit integer factors1/2, optional explicit sign reversal. Exact code owns factors, sum, compare, tie mapping and exact facts. Semantic implicit orientation remains model responsibility. UNKNOWN in any required child propagates; no silently dropping a term. Exact typed numeric facts use code only and never encoder arithmetic.
page_reader.decision: No strict semantic certificate. Knownness threshold is fit on disjoint calibration; any required candidate below threshold gives fallback/UNKNOWN. Otherwise maximize exact composition of semantic scores. Return raw scores, uncalibrated masses separately if used, source=semantic, certificate=unavailable, fallback boolean. Exact path returns probability not_applicable.

controls.description: The conditional cached Evidence Pages reader above

Same frozen base jointly encodes question/page; existing canonical CrossEncoderScorer 384-to128 GELU pattern with outputs relevance and directed normalized grade. Same relevant-page supervision and aggregate knownness form; field/family labels never inputs. Real cross forwards and costs retained.

Same page value/direction/knownness mechanism, but attention logits are frozen normalized page/question cosine; no learned attention projection. Train the remaining components under the identical recipe.

Training-only word1/2 and character3/5 TF-IDF ridge/logistic page relevance, ordinal extent and relative orientation. No hand-authored field registry/alias dictionary; validation chooses only the same frozen checkpoint rule, not vocabulary from held data. Persist learned vocabulary and all fits.
Train-only page-grade regressor with uniform attention and no question; same candidate data/knownness policy. Cheapest state-only quality control, not a frozen mock.

training.batch: full cached training set, accumulated in deterministic chunks if RAM requires
training.normalizer: Train-only per-coordinate mean/std floor0.01; frozen at deployment
training.checkpoint: Earliest minimum held-world validation objective, independent per neural arm; no development/final/calibration checkpoint selection
training.encoder: Entire encoder frozen eval, parameter hashes before/after; no adapter in this experiment

calibration.split: Disjoint calibration worlds only; first12 families/A fields
calibration.knownness_threshold: Fixed grid0.05..0.95 step0.05 maximizing candidate balanced known/unknown accuracy, then lower threshold on ties; no final tuning
calibration.ordinal_distribution: Optional descriptive Gaussian kernel on levels0,.25,.5,.75,1 around predicted directed extent; sigma grid[.025,.05,.075,.1,.15,.2,.3,.4], minimize calibration NLL, first tie. Report NLL/Brier/ECE and OOD separately; no calibration gate or strict certificate earned here

primary_metric: Final K4 exact-winner-set choice accuracy on supported atomic criteria, macro across20 families, with held4-family stratum separately
secondary_metrics: correct-new winner conditional on teacher-changing criterion/page swaps
mechanism_interventions: Reuse exact states under opposite/different criteria; reuse exact criterion under a relevant-page grade change, erasure or contradiction; independently zero question features, zero page features and replace learned attention by uniform attention at inference. Preserve all per-decision rows and direct model scores. Correct-new does not additionally require student change. Also report changed-to-new separately. Neural state/criterion use requires causal quality evidence, not nonzero gradients.

statistics.unit: Whole world, variants clustered; macro family weighting explicit; final320 worlds give64 property exposures per family under the balanced four-property schedule
statistics.intervals: Paired world-cluster bootstrap10000 seed0,95% descriptive CIs for all gates and controls. Quality gates are point-based mechanism screens only, not endgame NI. Internal cross NI uses one-sided95% world-bootstrap lower bound with margin0.05 on primary choice. With fewer20 discordant worlds, additionally require the one-sided95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the proportion of harmed worlds to be below0.05; a degenerate bootstrap alone cannot pass NI. Insufficient precision remains inconclusive.
statistics.intervention_unit: Paired world; no swap-count independent CI
statistics.multiple_claims: No neutral/competitor superiority claim; independent mechanism benefit requires Bonferroni correction across three differences: pages-lexical, intact-zero-question, intact-zero-page

statistical_scope_clarification: World-cluster intervals condition on the fixed authored property/rubric/wording inventory and random grade assignments. They do not measure uncertainty over independent human authors, templates or future semantic families. Holding a field or family out of training does not make repeated grade worlds independent semantic tasks. This clarification changes no counts, equations, gates, recipe, split or selection; no ECA model outcomes have been obtained.

gates.mechanism: Simultaneous corrected lower bounds on the three learned benefit differences must exceed0; relevant-page interventions must meet correct-new gate. UNKNOWN counts wrong on supported gold. Macro and held-family gates cannot be hidden by micro averages.

closed_regression: Replay existing CBF8 literals/aliases/compositions as explicitly closed diagnostics with identical typed exact states and source provenance. Literal path must remain100%; semantic regression differences reported, not rebranded fresh or used for checkpoint/threshold selection. No expanding a fixed four-axis registry to claim field-free transfer.
selection: All five controls run development. Only pages is eligible for this experiment's one final mechanism opening; no control result selects another architecture on the final. Control outcomes on the same sealed final are paired measurement, not arm/prompt selection. Persist checkpoints, calibration and immutable selection before final loading. Final outputs never tune.

failure_branches.pages_all_gates_pass: Replicate unchanged recipe on seeds11/13; all gates each. Then acquire fresh lawful neutral unstructured transfer and OOD evidence before primitive/product promotion or B-STEF.
failure_branches.cross_passes_pages_fails: Preregister one final-layer-only adaptation of the page encoder with unchanged corpus/reader/recipe controls on fresh final worlds/phrases, auditing state-interface failure. Do not widen the page head.
failure_branches.both_fail: Audit independent page/criterion truth, relation/grade ceilings and supervised conditional readout controls before any stronger encoder. Retire any demonstrated inadequate frozen page interface; preregister a targeted representation change using fresh final. Do not repeat pooled global numeric reconstruction.
failure_branches.cheap_or_blind_matches_pages: No learned mechanism promotion. Retain the simplest supported control; diagnose matching and grade interfaces before adding neural complexity.
failure_branches.unknown_only_fails: Audit relevant-page presence/contradiction detection with paired erasures; no lowering final trust thresholds or weakening exact/fallback policy. Any new reader gets a fresh preregistration and final pool.

resource_budget.performance_claim: Only after capability passes; same hardware interleaved full-path measurement, no head-only speed claim

artifacts: one DecisionIR per example and split/group/source SHA ledger
actual token IDs/masks and frozen caches
before/after full parameter hashes and gradient smoke
every control prediction and UNKNOWN reason
independent verifier and complete negative results
